note: Attacker-controlled input is copied into the global static_data buffer of 32768 bytes
config_open_for_fuzzing sets lexer end to static_data + size - 1, so the last valid byte is at offset size-2
After detecting the opening ''' multiline string delimiter at the end of the buffer, advance_n moves lexer->pos past the end of valid data
strncmp reads 3 bytes from lexer->pos which is beyond the static_data buffer boundary, causing a global-buffer-overflow READ 3
